'''Abbaji''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Iminec]] in the [[Kalee system/Legends|Kalee system]], located within the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Situated in the same [[Star system/Legends|system]] as [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]], the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Abbaji had two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and a habitable surface.<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Huk War]], a [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] conflict between the rival Kaleesh, a species native to Kalee system, and the [[Yam'rii]] species, the latter were known for colonizing and pillaging Abbaji.<ref name="TSGG" /> By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the planet fell within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] contested between both factions. Eventually, a few decades afterwards, Abbaji was bordered by the territory of the [[Pentastar Alignment]], an Imperial splinter movement of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Eventually, after the Empire's [[Battle of Ord Cantrell|collapse]], the Pentastar Alignment became part of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], which then bordered the Kalee system.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Insider 86|''Star Wars Insider'' 86]] article "[[Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous]]," written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and published in [[2006]].<ref name="TSGG" /> It was later mentioned [[2009|three years later]] in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square J-4.<ref name="TEA" />

Abbaji became the second planet in [[Star Wars]] universe known by that name, with ''The Essential Atlas'' placing it and [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]] in the same system, according to ''Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous''. The first planet known as [[Abbaji (Spar sector)|Abbaji]] was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'']] novel as a world near [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Due to this mistake, the planet Abbaji near Kalee was eventually deemed "Abbaji minor" by Jason Fry, although this [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] is thus far unofficial.<ref name="Fry">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31279316|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2010-09-27|time=8:19 am|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180314051039/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-152}}</ref>
